subject: general
question: What is the value of 3 sin² 30° + (3)/(5) cos² 60° − 2 sec² 45° ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Substitute standard values: sin 30° = 0.5, cos 60° = 0.5, sec 45° = √2

Expression = 3 × (0.5)² + 0.6 × (0.5)² − 2 × (√2)²

Expression = 3 × 0.25 + 0.6 × 0.25 − 2 × 2 = 0.75 + 0.15 − 4

Expression = 0.9 − 4 = −3.1

Convert decimal to fraction: −3.1 = −31/10

**∴ The correct answer is −31/10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 3 sin² 30° + 3/5 cos² 60° − 2 sec² 45°

**Values Used:**

sin 30° = 1/2

cos 60° = 1/2

sec 45° = √2

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3 × (1/2)² + 3/5 × (1/2)² − 2 × (√2)²

⇒ 3 × (1/4) + 3/5 × (1/4) − 2 × 2

⇒ 3/4 + 3/20 − 4

⇒ (3 × 5)/20 + 3/20 − (4 × 20)/20

⇒ 15/20 + 3/20 − 80/20

⇒ (15 + 3 − 80) / 20

⇒ −62 / 20

⇒ −31 / 10

**∴ The correct answer is −31/10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Trigonometric Ratios

sin 30° = cos 60° = 1/2 and sin 60° = cos 30° = √3/2.

Reciprocal Ratios

sec θ = 1/cos θ. Since cos 45° = 1/√2, then sec 45° = √2.

Pythagorean Identity

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1. This can be used to simplify expressions when the angle θ is the same.

BODMAS Rule

Always solve exponents (squares) first, then multiplication/division, and finally addition/subtraction from left to right.</p
